subject.title: fix(ui): prevent unsafe custodian nudge answers

question: Should this PR require a full hosted-wizard-awaiting state guard and live hosted-wizard proof before it can merge?
rationale: The desired safety boundary spans server wizard state and the web UI, while the present UI-only structured-card signal leaves a documented class of wizard prompts unprotected.

options.title: Require complete wizard-state protection
options.body: Block nudges whenever the hosted wizard awaits any answer, add non-card regression coverage, and require redacted live proof before merge.

options.title: Accept structured-card-only protection
options.body: Merge with the known non-card wizard-answer exposure as an explicitly accepted product and security risk.

recommendation.title: Require complete wizard-state protection
recommendation.body: Block nudges whenever the hosted wizard awaits any answer, add non-card regression coverage, and require redacted live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR history ties this contributor directly to the affected Custodian and gateway implementation boundary.
